executive_findings.pillar: 2 · Regulatory Market Hold Benchmark (Singles vs. Parlays)
executive_findings.verified_finding: Official Nevada Gaming Control Board Form NGC-31 Statewide data confirms Parlay Cards carry substantially higher operator hold than straight Football pools, underscoring why uncalibrated parlay multiplication destroys edge.
executive_findings.open_gap: Licensed point-in-time sportsbook closing odds and Same-Game Parlay (SGP) pricing feeds are not yet connected.

executive_findings.pillar: 3 · Official NFL Roster, Elevation & 90-Minute Inactive Mechanics
executive_findings.verified_finding: NFL Operations establishes a 53-man Active/Inactive List (up to 54–55 via Practice Squad elevations), a 48-player game-day active limit (47 if <8 offensive linemen), and mandatory Inactive List delivery 90 minutes pre-kickoff.
executive_findings.open_gap: Automated T-90m inactive scraper and reconciliation of a textual 2-game vs. 3-game elevation discrepancy on operations.nfl.com.

executive_findings.confirmed_benchmark: 7 club depth charts cross-checked vs. nfl.com/injuries/
executive_findings.open_gap: Historical snap-weighted EPA replacement drop-off curves per positional string tier remain uncomputed (left blank).

executive_findings.pillar: 5 · 2026 NFL Rulebook & Next Gen Stats Signal Inputs
executive_findings.verified_finding: The 2026 NFL Rulebook modifies kickoff setup-zone alignment (6-1-3), touchback spot on 50-yard-line kickoffs (6-1-5), and permits declared onside kicks at any time (6-1-6), directly shifting field-position and total-points distributions.
executive_findings.open_gap: Out-of-sample 2026 kickoff/touchback expected-points recalibration requires play-by-play ingestion.

executive_findings.verified_finding: Random variance cannot be eliminated from single NFL games, but luck in strategy selection is controlled via 8 strict gates: point-in-time freeze, game-grouped walk-forward CV, Brier/Log-Loss decomposition, CLV, NIST sample power, FDR adjustment, correlation caps, and prospective shadow runs.
executive_findings.open_gap: All strategy scores, correlations, and ranks are intentionally blank until historical play-by-play and odds archives are licensed.
